title: Normality ascends along arbitrary weakly etale ring maps
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings, possibly in different universes, and let $f:A\to B$ be weakly etale [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra], meaning that $f$ and the multiplication map $B\otimes_A B\to B$ are flat. Suppose $A$ is a normal ring [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]: for every prime $\mathfrak p\subset A$, the localization $A_{\mathfrak p}$ is a domain integrally closed in its fraction field. Then $B$ is a normal ring: for every prime $\mathfrak q\subset B$, the localization $B_{\mathfrak q}$ is a domain integrally closed in its fraction field. There is no Noetherian, domain, finite-presentation, locality or faithful-flatness assumption on $A$ or $B$. The zero target ring is permitted; if $A=0$, any unital $A$-algebra $B$ is also zero.

source.place: Agent extraction of the returned normal-chart proof, Steps 3 and 5: Tag 097Z (proetale-proposition-weakly-etale), combined with algebra.tex Tags 033C (algebra-lemma-normal-goes-up), 037D (algebra-lemma-colimit-normal-ring), and 033G (algebra-lemma-descent-normal). The combined ascent assertion is derived, not a verbatim assertion of 097Z.

proof.text: Work in a universe containing both rings (replace either by its universe lift if required). The lift is a ring isomorphism: primes, their localizations, monic equations and their solutions correspond, so normality is unchanged; the tensor products and their modules correspond too, preserving the given flatness conditions. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-existing-weakly-etale-indetale-refinement] to the given weakly etale map. Obtain $g:B\to C$ faithfully flat and ind-etale with $g\circ f:A\to C$ ind-etale. Faithful flatness is required only of this refinement, not of $f$.

By [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra], present the composite algebra as $C\cong\varinjlim_{i\in I}C_i$, for a small filtered diagram of finitely presented etale $A$-algebras. Each $A\to C_i$ is an etale ring map, so $\operatorname{Spec}C_i\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale in the sense of Stacks 02GI. For every $i$, apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-over-normal-ring-normal] to $A\to C_i$ and the assumed normality of $A$. Thus every $C_i$ is normal. This uses normal rings, not the stronger assumption that $A$ is a domain.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-normal-ring] to the composite of this filtered diagram with the forgetful functor to commutative rings; the forgetful functor from $A$-algebras to rings preserves filtered colimits, as the ring colimit carries the induced $A$-algebra structure through any $\iota_i$ (independent of $i$ since $I$ is connected) and has the universal property among $A$-algebra cocones. The node gives normality of its colimit, hence of $C$ under the displayed isomorphism. No injectivity of transition maps or Noetherian hypothesis is needed.

Apply [lem-sfb-faithfully-flat-normal-ring-descent] to $g:B\to C$, faithfully flat by step 1, with normal target by step 3. It gives exactly that every $B_{\mathfrak q}$ is an integrally closed domain. Carry this back across a universe lift if one was used. If $B=0$ there are no primes and the conclusion is vacuous; if $A=0$, unitality gives $1_B=0_B$, so $B=0$.
